# sspi_roles (Data Source)

Lists every role available to be assigned on the SSPI appliance.

Corresponds to `GET /sspi/iam/roles`. Returns all results in a single page (no offset/page_size pass-through).

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) The roles available to be assigned via `sspi_role_binding`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>

### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable role name.
- `role` (String) Machine-readable role name (e.g. `ENTERPRISE_ADMIN`, `AUDITOR`).
